source.title: First report of the non-native Midas Cichlid, Amphilophus citrinellus (Gunther, 1864), in Laguna de Bay, Philippines

record.taxonomicReview: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes lists Amphilophus citrinellus (Günther 1864) as valid. This is a nomenclatural cross-check, not a re-identification of a specimen.
record.dateLimit: The article says fishers caught the fish in February 2019 and that BFAR-NIFTC sent the sample to NFRDI-GFL on 2019-02-06. The submission date is not treated as the exact capture date.
record.sourceLocality: Kinagatan, Talim Island, Binangonan, Rizal, near the island shore
record.captureMethod: Hook and line, as reported by the article
record.sampleProvenance: The article says the specimen was obtained from local fishers and submitted by BFAR-NIFTC to the NFRDI Genetic Fingerprinting Laboratory. No museum voucher/catalog number is reported.

identification.reportedComparison: The source reports matching GenBank references JN024800, JN024798 and HQ654655, with a distinct neighbor-joining clade at 100% bootstrap support.

rightsReview.repositoryAccess: The official NFRDI repository and journal page provide the article for public reading.
rightsReview.itemLicense: No license statement was found on the article page, repository item metadata, or reviewed PDF.
rightsReview.journalPolicyContext: The current TPJF policy states CC BY-NC 4.0 for articles submitted under that policy. It does not explicitly say whether that license applies retrospectively to this 2019 item; no article-level license was confirmed.
rightsReview.disposition: Keep as research-only source evidence. Do not reproduce the article, image, table or sequence; do not project the occurrence into the public app until item-specific reuse terms are confirmed.

decision.reason: This is one source-reported fish capture with a month-level date, named shore locality and molecular identification. The site text links it to Laguna de Bay, but no coordinates or physical specimen catalog number are given. Rights and the exact article license remain unresolved; no public projection is approved.

nonClaims: One captured fish does not establish abundance, population status, establishment, current presence, or a lake-wide checklist.
The article's term first report is preserved as the authors' description, not used to assert that no earlier observation existed.
The reported invasive-risk language is not a measured ecological impact for this sample.
The locality is not converted into a point, shoreline segment, jurisdiction boundary, or fishing-access location.
The natural-diet paragraph concerns general species literature, not a gut-content result from this Laguna de Bay specimen.
